gadgets.note: a0 is true when a takes color 0.
a1 is true when a takes color 1.
b0 is true when b takes color 0.
b1 is true when b takes color 1.
c0 is true when c takes color 0.
c1 is true when c takes color 1.

frames.caption: Node a becomes the variables a0, a1, one per color, and 2 clauses: (a0 | a1) says a takes a color, and (!a0 | !a1) says it takes only one.
Node b becomes the variables b0, b1, one per color, and 2 clauses: (b0 | b1) says b takes a color, and (!b0 | !b1) says it takes only one.
Node c becomes the variables c0, c1, one per color, and 2 clauses: (c0 | c1) says c takes a color, and (!c0 | !c1) says it takes only one.
Edge {a,b} becomes 2 clauses, (!a0 | !b0), (!a1 | !b1): a and b never take the same color.
Edge {b,c} becomes 2 clauses, (!b0 | !c0), (!b1 | !c1): b and c never take the same color.
The formula can be satisfied exactly when the graph can be colored with 2 colors: a node takes the color whose variable is true.
